value.summary: Build a retail e-commerce storefront with account access, dashboard, transactional email, mobile notifications, core mobile flows, responsive SEO-friendly public pages, and high-fidelity design. The brief contains unresolved conflicts about card payments, SSO, mobile platform, regional data access, and launch timing.

requirements.text: Provide enterprise SSO using the client's identity provider; Azure AD is a possible but unconfirmed provider.
Provide user registration, login, and password reset with email verification.
Provide a main dashboard with widgets, filters, and empty states.
Send mobile push notifications for key events.
Provide native or cross-platform screens for core user flows; the delivery platform is undecided.
Provide public pages with responsive layouts and SEO basics.
Produce high-fidelity mockups and component styles.
Define access so admin users can see all data and determine whether regional managers are restricted to their own region.
Deliver the launch scope on a timeline that must be clarified: the brief states both about three months and six weeks.
Prefer proven technology; budget is flexible.

ambiguities: The brief says payments are not needed in phase 1 but also requires customers to pay by card at checkout.
Enterprise SSO is required, but the identity provider is unconfirmed; Azure AD is only a possibility.
The mobile experience could be native, cross-platform, or a PWA; the brief does not resolve the platform.
Regional managers may be restricted to their own region, or may have broader access; the intended policy is unclear.
The launch target is stated as both about three months and six weeks, and it is unclear whether the full feature set is required for either date.
assumptions: The listed storefront capabilities are intended requirements, except where the brief explicitly presents contradictory or undecided notes.
Card checkout is treated as a requested capability, but its phase-1 inclusion is not assumed.
No specific payment provider, email service, push-notification service, or identity-provider integration details are specified.
risks: A six-week deadline for the full feature set may be infeasible, particularly if card payments, SSO, mobile delivery, and detailed access controls are all in scope.
Unresolved payment scope could cause substantial rework in checkout design, integration, testing, and compliance planning.
Unconfirmed identity-provider and mobile-platform choices may affect architecture and delivery estimates.
Unclear regional access rules create a risk of unauthorized data exposure or unnecessary implementation complexity.
The brief does not define the dashboard data, key notification events, core mobile flows, or SEO acceptance criteria, so scope and acceptance may vary.

unknowns.question: Must card payments be implemented in phase 1, despite the note that payments are not needed?
unknowns.why_it_matters: Including checkout payments adds payment-provider integration, checkout and payment-state handling, and additional testing; excluding them materially reduces scope.

scenario_if_yes.title: Implement card checkout and payment lifecycle
Integrate payment provider in checkout UI
Test payment flows, failures, and edge cases

unknowns.question: Is Azure AD the client's identity provider, and is SSO required for the launch scope?
unknowns.why_it_matters: The provider and protocol determine integration work, configuration, and authentication testing; SSO may also be a launch dependency.

scenario_if_yes.title: Integrate and configure Azure AD SSO
Test SSO login, logout, and account-linking flows

unknowns.question: Should the mobile experience be a native/cross-platform app, or is a PWA acceptable?
unknowns.why_it_matters: A native or cross-platform app has different implementation, release, and push-notification work from a PWA and can significantly change effort.

scenario_if_yes.title: Build native or cross-platform mobile core flows
Prepare mobile builds and release configuration

unknowns.question: Must regional managers be restricted to their own region, or may they see data across regions?
unknowns.why_it_matters: Region-level restrictions require authorization rules and data filtering across relevant views and APIs; the answer affects security design and testing.

scenario_if_yes.title: Implement region-scoped authorization and data filtering
Test role and region access boundaries

unknowns.question: Is the required launch date six weeks away, or approximately three months away?
unknowns.why_it_matters: The schedule determines whether the full scope can be delivered as one launch or needs prioritization, phased delivery, or additional capacity.

scenario_if_yes.title: Replan scope and delivery milestones for a six-week launch
